notes.title: Update "Jotuns" is now live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713871/e9f623428ca5826251761da595e0c1856c2d6182.png[/img]

Hi folks,

as promised before, today is the day we release update 1.0.10 AKA “Jotuns”. As you can guess from the update title, we have new bosses! But before disclosing more details about what's new in this big free update, I’d like to focus on some other game news first.

First of all: Niffelheim (single player mode only) was released on 20th September (a few days ago) on Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch platforms. Over the past six months, we have been working on game balancing and porting to these consoles. So now feel free to congratulate us and play the game on your console. The console release includes the latest update by default.
Also, thanks to the active member of the Niffelheim community Brechler Zsolt, the game is fully translated into Hungarian. Kudos to Brechler for his work and support!
 
[h1]And now - more news about the latest update.[/h1] 

1. We’ve added new bosses who will attack castles – the mighty Jotuns!
2. Also added Repair Kits to allow you to repair currently equipped items.
3. Added scrolls of weapons and ammunition- these are needed to craft cool weapons and equipment. Certain bosses will drop these scrolls.
4. The balance of all weapons has been tweaked.
5. The balance of almost all mobs has been changed. Now the mobs will appear stronger – so you should definitely think twice before start picking a fight.
6. Now almost all armor (except for Hunter’s Armor) can be crafted in workshops. However, you’ll need scrolls for cool swag.
7. All weapons can be crafted in workshops. You’ll need scrolls for cool weapons.
8. The strength of weapons and tools has been increased.
9. Later on, in the game you’ll find it very challenging to kill bosses without potions. (I was able to do this eventually, but definitely not during the first attempt).
10. The chance of getting rare stones from chests of bosses has been adjusted. Some stones will only appear near spiders, some objects - near trolls only, and the witch’s skull can only be found by the undead.
11. Alchemy and kitchen recipes have been changed. Now you will be able to cook pig meat from the first level. Crafting rare potions will now become simpler. As mentioned above – you will need A LOT of potions.
12. Wave timing for mobs and ultimatums, as well as the day duration,  has been changed. The dynamics are slightly improved.
13. Over time, new items appear in the store.
14. Ore generation has been improved. (Though titanium ore was rather rare during my latest walkthrough, that’s random parameters for you)
15. Character development has been balanced.
16. Additional fixes for grave loot and various flora. The chance to get a Hare amulet is at 100%. Some achievements can now be unlocked faster.
16. Various bug fixes and minor tweaks.
 
Well, are you ready to check out the new update?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713871/c0bda2f76984c674aaaa280011baf52e5c3f05b7.png[/img]

I completed the new version of the game in 65 days. It was quite interesting and difficult, even for me! :) Definitely worth checking out! Especially since many of you play Niffelheim way better than us.

I will create a topic in the community and post a screenshot of my result. I encourage you to post your results there, but no cheating, please! Odin's eye sees everything! 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/351100/discussions/0/1629663905426425272/

Let us know your opinion about the update here and in the Discord channel. Create new topics in the community and tell us how you got to Asgard!
 
Thanks for your support,
Ellada Games Team

notes.title: Update #0.9.024
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/211753a51714e0323db7c381edf1d902f73e0e21.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

I’ve got three great news for you:
1. Our latest bugfixes have turned into a full scale 0.9.024 update. Thanks for all the feedback!
2. The game release is scheduled for September 26th.
3. We are currently working on Korean localization, which will be available on release.


Details on the update:

[h1]New features:[/h1]

1. The Horde has been introduced in the game! Now every few days the Horde will assault your castle. You need to build and fortify it so that the skeletons do not plunder your castle. Just place more weapons in the fortress and you’ll be fine. After the plunder mobs and bots will disappear. Their goal is to loot your castle you, and, well, it's possible to kill you along the way :)
2. Ultimatums will appear very rarely, and there will be enough time to fulfill them. They will demand gifts that you can find in the alchemic workshop. We recommend fulfilling these tasks.
3. We have added various visual effects to mobs and players. Burn them or beat them – it’s a lot of fun :) Also you will see a message stating that a certain effect is applied or received. Bleeding, stun, burning, poisoning and hitting!
4. In single player mode the game is PAUSED once you open the interface! I think this should make everyone happy. Obviously, there is no pause in multiplayer mode.
5. Seeds are now in the consumables section.
6. Character description is added to character selection.
7. New Labor Skills are introduced. Level these up, to spend less satiety on digging and chopping. Check out the skills screen.
8. There will be reports indicating that an item is going to break soon and when something gets broken.
9. While you are cutting down trees or digging, an axe and a pick are displayed under the hot panel.
10. The castle is using its stationary defenses while its its health is over 10%.
11. Hints appear over the character informing about the next action you should perform.
12. From now on you will be able to stun enemies, but you also may be stunned by some enemies.
13. Some effects may have additional effects - check the item description.
14. When skeletons kill you, they return to their places of dislocation, and no longer hang around the corpse

[h1]Balance tweaks:[/h1]

Effect powers of mobs increase along with the difficulty level.
You can now craft Portal Scrolls.
Torch inflicts only little damage, but can ignite most targets.

Actually there have been a lot of balance changes and there is no point in writing everything down: durability of items has been increased, some skills were changed, as well as some recipes and various characteristics of mobs and heroes, including buffs and debuffs. Once again I’d like to thank the players for the feedback, it’s a great aid in balance improvement. We are going to continue balancing, so please keep sharing your thoughts.


[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
1. Inventory issues have been fixed.
2. Loot issues have been fixed
3. The portal doesn’t get caved in after an earthquake.
4. Issue with mini-buildings and seed durability has been fixed
5. Various bugs with item durability
6. Various achievements have been fixed
7. Statistics and trophies have been fixed
8. Hel’s appearance has been fixed.
9. Issue with selected items disappearing on window closing has been fixed.
10. You can die on the throne.
11. Woodcutter experience has been fixed in multiplayer mode.

And a few more minor fixes involving GUIs and controls.

Well, see you on September 26th? :)
Ellada Games Team

notes.title: The biggest update 0.9.023
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/6aac6044aaf7dcb1339912f1a1e1908777790545.jpg[/img]

Greetings to all Niffelheim players,

After 5 months, we are finally ready to release our largest update for the game as of yet. A lot of what has been promised was finally realized. All that is left now is to include a few locations, enable a couple of effects, and we’ll be all set for the game’s release - so the game finally will be released soon. And right now, I'll try to tell you everything that has been implemented during this time, and how much it affected the game. Well, and you can check everything by yourself - so do not hesitate to run the game. Special topic for the update 0.9.023 on our forum.

[h1]Global changes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]New characters - our Viking is joined by Shaman, Berserker and Valkyrie! Every character has its own advantages, but my current choice is Valkyrie!
[*]New interfaces - completely new and modern. We have considered all your suggestions concerning management and inventory (more space!) I already mentioned these changes before - check out the rest yourself.
[*]Full controller support - we’ve taken all the nuances of control into account, made a lot of improvements, and now you can - or rather you should! - play using a controller. The game displays buttons for PS4, XboxOne, SwitchPro controllers and, of course, Steam Controller. Oh yeah, and my favorite Xbox360 and PS3 Dualshock, too.
[*]Descriptions for all the items in the game - now you can learn a lot about these: how to use them and much more. And if there is no description, it’s implied that the item is self-explanatory - for example, a pinecone is a pinecone! :)
[*]A new combat system including buffs and debuffs - oh, there's so much we've implemented that it would take too much time to cover all the changes - you should play and see for yourself. Some of the most important things - you will see the current active effects on your character; the enemies now have armor and various abilities. So don’t go picking fights, and you can check your stats in the inventory.
[*]All the weapons and ammunition has a new stat: durability. When inflicting or receiving damage you spend the durability of your equipment.
[*]NEW balance - we removed some things from the game, but implemented a more logical balance. We will continue to improve it based on your feedback. Something of the things will return to the game, we also have some new items in the game! But now - new crafting, new prices, and a completely new system of damage and defense.
[*]The seeds and animals, that can be used to produce various items on your farms, now also have durability. Once their durability is depleted, they will disappear.
[*]NEW bosses - meet new trolls and all sorts of evil dead creatures!
[*]TUTORIAL - everyone was waiting for this to happen! 127 000 Steam players added our game to their wish lists - it's time to buy the game! Our tutorial is a journal with 12 topics covering the main features of the game. We will add new topics later on if necessary.
[*]Earthquake - every few days your dungeons will collapse, and the resources and chest in the dungeons will be updated.
[/olist]

[h1]Minor improvements[/h1]
[olist]
[*]At night, skeletons spawn in the upper world. They won’t attack the castle, but will be looking for you.
[*]New trophies (lamb, porcupine and spider).
[*]New security system for castles. Towers are equipped with stationary weapons with only ammunition supplied later on.
[*]The production process on your farms is shown on a progress bar so you can easily find out how much time is left until the next item.
[*]We’ve added UI tip in the gaming world. These can be disabled in the game settings.
[*]When you equip a full set, the ammunition cells change showing that a set is assembled.
[*]You can immediately unload your inventory or take all items out of a chest at once.
[*]Portal fragments and the dragon statuette are placed in a special bag - there is no interaction with other items whatsoever, so you won’t lose any of them.
[*]Skills are now activated automatically - there are only 7 professions that improve your character. With each level, your character gets +5 HP.
[*]There is an event system that will notify you about what is happening in the world.
[*]In the journal you will see all your tasks, including already completed ones, as well as stories from various NPCs.
[*]The Diplomacy tab shows the statistics of your character, as well as other players.
[*]After death the character receives a permanent debuff, which can stack up to 5 times and is removed only by a Regeneration Potion.
[*]The character bar displays the effects that are active at the moment.
[*]After the damage is dealt, you’ll see the numbers showing the amount of inflicted damage. Yellow numbers depict a critical strike.
[/olist]

As always, we are looking forward to receiving your comments and feedback. The release is very near, we are planning to some improvement to visual effects and complete addition of the remaining two locations. The release date will be announced once we’re done polishing the game :)

Subscribe to our groups on Steam.


Have fun playing nice games,
Ellada Games Team

as promised, today I'm going to tell you about the new inventory in the game. Now there will be more space, lots of filters and convenient controls.
All right, first things first:

From now on the inventory will include 6 bags with 40 slots each.

[h1]Weapons and tools.[/h1]All kinds of weapons, arrows and tools are automatically placed into this "bag".
[h1]Ammunition.[/h1] All your armor and shields will be here.
[h1]Supplies.[/h1] Potions and cooked food. Anything you could need on the road.
[h1]Consumables.[/h1] All the stuff you can use for hunting (traps) or while moving through dungeons (doors, portals and lamps), as well as all kinds of living creatures and amulets.
[h1]Resources.[/h1] Everything you use for crafting, but also plants that can be used for medicine – so this is something you’ll have to explore.
[h1]Quest.[/h1] You won’t be able to do anything with this bag:) All items are put in here automatically and automatically consumed. This is a place exclusively for the statuette that activates the dragon and for fragments of the portal to Asgard. When you are playing in multiplayer mode, the entire team has access to this bag and sees this inventory.
 
Item descriptions are displayed under your inventory. Here you will see stat comparison for weapons and ammunition, as well as a brief description of the object and what do you need it for. (We are still working on the texts).
 
You see all the equipped items to the right of the inventory – to check what you can use in combat, without opening other interfaces. Here you see the appearance of your character with the basic four characteristics.
 
And below you see active keyboard/gamepad tips for convenient managing of your collection.
 
Next time – more info about the chests :)
 
Have fun playing,
Ellada Games team

notes.title: Update 0.9.019 [Drought] & 40% OFF
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/a1ce4d408ec778808b40b584b19f061b777811a2.png[/img]

Hi, everyone,

It’s fall now in our world, leaves are changing colors and it’s rather cold outside (our team is from the North :) ). That’s why we’ve decided to release new Update 0.9.019 and announce the fall discount. Highly recommended for everyone doesn’t have to go to school early in the morning :)

[h1]And now it’s time for some Niffelheim news :)[/h1]

Although Niffelheim is a cold and misty world, the witch can make it even nastier and unleash a ‘Drought’ upon your land. We’ve been conventionally calling this event a drought so far, but actually, this is a pretty strong curse causing all rabbits to disappear and resulting in flora ceasing to spawn, trees drying out, and the bushes having no berries. And only rare mushrooms that you’ll never find anywhere else in Niffelheim begin to appear in your world. In the future, we’ll add beautiful visual effects to this event :)

Now let us delve into some details.

[h1]What’s new:[/h1]
[list]
[*] You should consider accepting witch’s ultimatums, otherwise, she casts a ‘Drought’.
[*] Daytime mobs don’t spawn in drought.
[*] Plants cease to spawn, but rare mushrooms appear.
[*] Mushrooms grow at nighttime; some plants grow only during the daytime. For example, bees (we are testing such conditions so far).
[*] There are small stones instead of large ones now. Players don’t need a pickaxe to collect them.
[/list]
In the future, we plan to add a possibility of cursing other lands with the help of the witch or even order a skeleton unit to attack your enemy’s castle. But it’s only in plans so far :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/fe133987dbbe65c93532234b38573c2cfd44c7ca.png[/img]

[h1]Balance improvements:[/h1]
[list]
   
[*] Pickaxe and axe can be crafted from stones and twigs. They can be collected in the upper world, no tools needed. Stones and twigs can be also used for building the first-level carpentry workshop. So, it’s impossible to stay in the game with nothing in your pockets.
[*] Dragon deals more damage and is a lot easier to be activated.
[*] Bot’s chests are constantly replenished, so they can be robbed forever. But they also constantly develop.
[*] Twigs can be collected from bushes.
[*] We increased the iron ore deposits.
[*] Throne restores health faster.
[*] Now throne placed next to the kitchen in the upper world also restores health.
[*] Skeleton waves attacking the castle will appear only if the witch gives you an ultimatum and you fail to meet its conditions. Waves will march to the castle only from one randomly picked side. [/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/fe133987dbbe65c93532234b38573c2cfd44c7ca.png[/img]

During this time, we managed to update the game [u]to the new Unity 5.6[/u], so in future, we’ll be able to add beautiful effects. Also, we redesigned several scenes to [u]support screens with 21:9 aspect ratio[/u] and will release this update 0.9.020 separately in a week or so.

Now our team is working on the buff system and the new item balance. We’re also working on the crow and will add it to the game very soon. [u]Fixing multiplayer bugs with mobs appearing and disappearing[/u]. And creating new interfaces that you’ll certainly like, but it’s a lot of work to do :)

[b]We are always looking forward to your feedback and bug reports!
Sincerely yours,
Ellada Games Team[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/5c66ffae854ad180f4a8555d3dfd789169a3ada4.png[/img]

We’ve also launched official [url=https://discord.gg/5TdnqKu]Discord server[/url]. Let’s communicate more! :)

1. We're introducing ore types that you will be digging for under the ground. a new update 0.9.017 is ready. Below is a list of changes, that are very important for the game  ending introduction.

4. A team can only own a single land. You will no longer be able to buy more lands.

6. After having activated the dragon, the temple is no longer accessible for you and your team.
7. If a land is empty (no AI or real players), there will be no Mine.
8. If an AI player destroys your castle, it's going to rob you a little bit :) However the items inside your vault will be safe.
9. You can plunder AI chests, something will be in there.

Changes to bosses and dungeons system:
1. From now on hermit priests are always located in the first cave of your dungeon. You can easily find them. There is one priest per cave.
2. After killing a boss inside a cave you get a portal fragment to Asgard. Make sure to collect these. The Portal will soon be launched.
3. Bosses have a lot less health from now on, but their health will be increased with every portal fragment you get. This system may be also used in future with some mobs).
4. Bosses in a cave can change.

2. Doors are pre-installed in dungeons, where digging is enabled.

6. From now on doors are also installed on the upper floors.

2. Fixed bug with irresponsive bosses.
3. Fixed bug with the "Complete 10 quests" achievement.

Currently we are working on diggable dungeons: some ground types will be harder to break, but you will be able to tell right away that there is gold in there. Also we are going to improve the flora and introduce drought as the Witch's curse, as well as some other tasks. 

Next we are going to add the Beggar and the Raven for new story quests. After that we are going to activate the Portal and the Crypt. The dragon will be stored inside the Crypt. These are our main goals for the moment, and we are doing our best to implement all of these ASAP.
 
Have fun playing,
Ellada Games Team.

notes.title: Day/night and satiety (Update 0.9.016)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/11c6a7c0bcda8bcd975f7bd1fb6ef4b6c4f646ea.png[/img]

Hi everyone, please welcome a new update 0.9.016. We've added a lot of features and would like to guide you through them.

One important note before you begins to read about the new features! Not all features are visible at the moment and not all information is shown to you, but I would like to warn you that there will be some serious interface changes and players will get full info on events, player statuses, objectives etc. We will make sure that you will know about all events in the game. But our first priority is the core gameplay after that comes full interface remake and polishing.

Also is there is some unlocalized text – please don't worry. We guarantee full support of all 10 featured localization languages. Sometimes we try to amass some text volume to send it to translation rather than bug our translators with a few words. Our apologies and please don’t worry about that :)

:bullhead: [h1]1.Day and night cycle.[/h1] From now on the game features daytime and nighttime. An indicator is displayed in to top right corner that shows the time of day and what day you are playing. This was necessary to balance the game difficulty and show how many days you are surviving in Niffelheim. Also the creatures in the upper world react to time of the day (more info below). The events in the game will depend on how long you are playing, which opens a lot of possibilities for game balance in the future :) The upper world looks the same day or night at the moment, but we will try to visualize nighttime once we start working on visual effects.

:headache: [h1]2. Satiety.[/h1]This is a standard characteristic for survival games. So before the important characteristics were Stamina and Health, now these are Satiety and Health. Stamina will be depleted and filled up faster. From now on everything you eat in the game will increase your Satiety, and potions and charms will fill up your Health. Please note that your Health will decrease if your Satiety is depleted. Also your character will inflict less damage when the Satiety is low. Both Satiety and Health are indicated with new bars.

:iamold: [h1]3. We've also developed some passive abilities for all characters.[/h1] New characters will be introduced in the game: Valkyrie, Berserker and Shaman with different features and abilities. The currently available Viking gets the ability Stun. This means that there is a chance to stun the enemy when battling mobs (I will get you the exact number once we complete the final balancing, currently we are using 5% chance for testing). Some mobs are exposed to stun (currently these are skeletons) and if the ability works, they will just stand still allowing you to destroy them during the effect time. As mentioned above, in future this will be displayed in the GUI and visible to you, and we're also going to add some effects on mobs.
 
:iamtheking: [h1]4. The animals in the upper world react to day and night changes.[/h1] Non-aggressive animal appear only through daytime, at night you will meet the predators.

:ihaveseen: [h1]5. We've started adding new texts to the game that have been in development for some time.[/h1] Currently we've updated the objective and reward texts for Priests in the dungeons. After some changes we are going to add more characters in the game to introduce the world of Niffelheim (for example the Raven that will tell you more about the world and issue quests).

Among other things during work on new structures we've made some optimization and reduced FPS sinking.


 
[h1] Bugfixes:[/h1]
1. Fixed bug with the rat trophy.
2. Fixed bug with character falling through dungeon levels.
3. You don't have to kill hedgehogs to summon bunnies (you know what I'm talking about if you've played the game a year ago:) )
4. Stone`s loot in multiplayer issues fixed.

[h1] What we are working on now[/h1]

Naturally the development continues in many directions. Some features are added to the game without notice and stay hidden for now, as some other features are not ready yet. But at the moment we are working on the castle destruction system, Players will be able to rob their neighbours. Losing the castle won’t mean losing the game, but you will be robbed (in the following update). This feature is made to introduce the ending about getting to Asgard. Also we are working on optimization and features of flora. We are aiming to make the Witch more interesting :) Also we are working on dungeon improvement to make it easier to find the black priests. The visuals for the last world are being drawn. New GUI schemes and game controls are in development, including schemes for game controller.

There has been a lot of text today, but if you get the time – take a look at the update and tell us your thoughts on changes (or bugs!) :)


Sometimes this update may lead to losing your saved games and gaming progress. Please accept our apologies if that happens, but we are doing our best to guarantee compatibility for each version, especially after big updates of data and project architecture.

[h1]Wishing you a sunny summer,
Ellada Games Team[/h1]

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/3a4af6b2de189e216bf8992e8cca6bcbaea932eb.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

Please welcome the new Niffelheim update 0.9.015 introducing the automated castle defense. We’ve implemented a previous community suggestion - now the castle towers attack enemies providing there is enough ammunition and weapons. Place a weapon in the top slot and ammunition in the lower slot.
 
To allow your tower to shoot at attacking and other aggressive mobs, the towers must be build and have over 90% health. If the castle health drops below 90% the towers cease fire. 
 
You can use various weapons depending on the tower type.
Wooden Towers - Crossbow only.
Clay Towers - Crossbow and Ballista.
Stone Towers - Crossbow, Ballista or a Tower Mortar.
You’ll have to place weapons for each tower, as shown in the picture - both left and right towers, or else only the one equipped with everything required will shoot at the enemies.

We’ve introduced 3 tower turrets that can be crafted at the Sawmill,
 [h1] 1. Crossbow - fires any arrows. [/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/dd4541f745fb42723c0ffc53042f44c9e61062d5.png[/img]


[h1]2. Ballista - fires boulders (boulders can also be crafted at the Sawmill) [/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/5355af16280f728e9ff79c0d8435327ed2179614.png[/img]

[h1]3. Tower Mortar - fires any cannon balls.[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/c9288183d30174bd90adef4fd230ae811a8055e1.png[/img]

 
[h1]And yes, from now on, blizzard does not affect the speed of your character. Now it’s simply a natural phenomenon :)[/h1]

We are still working on the game’s features and polishing the details. The localization of new terms is still in progress, so please be warned there may be some minor unlocalized texts. Soon you will find out more about the new features and gameplay mechanics. New NPCs are also in development. 
 
Another interesting feature that we’re about to launch in the game is the day and night cycle.

Thank you for your patience,
Ellada Games Team

- The GUI on your screens will appear slightly increased or decreased in size, depending on your screen size. But now the GUI parts will surely not interfere

- Shields and traps now have a Durability stat. What does it mean? From now on if you are defending using a shield (using keyboard key C) you won't get any incoming damage, but your shield will be affected instead receiving the corresponding damage. Over the time the durability will be decreased and eventually shield will be destroyed and simply disappear.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/20fdc13d12ec2728ca99b028e41e6a763718e0c6.png[/img]

- Durability of traps is reflected in the number of uses. The most durable trap allows 8 uses. The durability progress of an item is displayed in percentage in the top right corner of the slot.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/428478bd22b3500ad0a722f0ea1c8e3750cab7c5.png[/img]

- Controls in the Store have been altered. Item purchasing using the mouse has been simplified. Now when using LMB on buying you will get a single item at a time until there are no more items left in stack. Also you can sell everything by dropping it to an empty slot. But there are also buttons to modify the process: Left Shift +RMB – buy\sell a full stack, Left Ctrl + RMB – buy\sell a single item (by the way, the full key controls are available via link). I am going to describe the controls within inventory in the next clause.

- So, what is new in the inventory controls. Left Shift + LMB – take a half of stack, Left Ctrl + LMB – take a single item from stack, Left Alt + LMB – add a single item to the stack.  

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/351100/discussions/0/135513549090795807/] Game`s controls[/url]


- Also from now you will find set bonuses in the item description (displayed on mouse hover) – in case the item is a part of a set..

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/515c01e9902725aa4b75c6726623e77101a91cb1.png[/img]

- Now loot drops around the character instead of falling under his feet, meaning you will be able to examine it and pick it up easily :)

- Following your request we've added floor number display in the underground dungeons. The floor number is now displayed on a plate next to the door. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/18c09934d0aa81a774736ed6af074a617e78c814.png[/img]

- Also the durability of each castle part will be displayed during construction.

- Based on your feedback we’ve added an auto pause (the feature is available only in SINGLE player mode). So from now on if you go to get yourself a cup of coffee, answer the phone or go outside for a walk, the game will be paused after 2 minutes just like you’ve pressed the Esc key. 

- When you hover mouse cursor over the experience stars in the character window, your current experience will be displayed along with the value you need to reach to level up.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/d48e6e00890db3e1beb1e704ddfca0ec35465728.png[/img]

- We’ve lowered money costs for buying land and activating the dragon for testing purposes. 

These are still not final, but we are carefully reviewing your feedback and working on the new balance system.)

Fixed bugs:
1. The bug with the boss in the last underground cave. Naturally, only a handful of players has reached this point in the game. But I assure you that we got the report on this bug from a player who cleared the entire dungeon – luckily we have a map now :)
2. Fixed some of the wolf's animations to stop its body parts from disappearing.
 
Dear players, we are still working on:
1. Quests and game balancing
2. NPCs for quests
3. Full gamepad support.
4. Consideration of all chests when crafting.
5. Weapon uniqueness (against mobs and castles).
6. Introduction of a female character – the Valkyrie.
7. Castle towers shooting at enemies.

All mentioned features are soon to be introduced )
Happy playing,
Ellada Games Team

notes.title: HotFix 0.9.8 and News
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
 
We have fixed a small bug with quests in Multiplayer mode. Now all players will be able to complete quests.

I'd also like to take a moment to talk about work in progress and further plans.

Currently we are introducing a new GUI and control system to improve game controls via mouse and keyboard, as well as using a gamepad. It's taking more time than initially planned as we've had to migrate to a new game engine version and rewrite the code for GUI and controls. But this will allow us more possibilities for introducing new features.

What new interface features are going to be added?
1. A quick access panel for switching between weapons and using various items and food;
2. A diplomacy window for managing the list of players by the game host;
3. Players will be able to fully undress (and dress again) the character. The hero will be able to attack without any equipped weapons (head butt and kick);
4. Crafting will become more convenient;
5. A more convenient item sorting in the inventory. You will be able to quickly relocate item stacks, as well as pick up a half of a stack and put a single item in a slot.

So there are a lot of positive changes coming. Maybe not everything will be done at once, but we will do our best to introduce all planned features ASAP. Stay tuned for more info as we progress.

What's next?
Here is some info on the features we're going to introduce after finishing work on the new GUI. These features are mostly based on player feedback and have been requested by the game community. Thank you for your comments once again!

1. New, quicker animations for the main character and monsters. And the character is going to run faster! A new attribute "Endurance" will be added.
2. A map of the underground dungeons. Yes, we will add it! :)
3. Portals for quick relocation from dungeons to your castle and back.
4. Crafting in a workshop will consider resources from all chests in the castle. You won't have to run around picking up resources in your inventory. It will be enough to sort the collected items at your option :)
5. Players will be able to summon a new NPC for defending the castle by activating a special scroll.
6. More food with simple recipes (mostly meat).
7. The castles will be able to shoot down nearby enemies. Players will have to craft some special weapons and required ammunition.
8. Three new playable characters.
9. New quests and new storyline characters, including the Norse god Odin :) And my favorite character - a spirit assistant :))
 
Naturally, we are going to work on the game balancing, also considering your feedback.

Most designs are ready and the work on animation has already started. This list of new features is not definite, we will disclose more info later on :)

We will do our best to add more features ASAP.
        	
The next update (ver. 0.9.9) is scheduled for late October, as we have some serious GUI and control testing ahead of us. But we will be sure to get back to you with more news until then!

Good luck, everyone, and thanks for your support!
Ellada Games Team

notes.notes:
09/09/2016 UPD: Few bug fixing

Hi everyone,

Finally we are done with the new multiplayer mode. But before please let me tell you about the latest bug fixes.


Fixed issues:

1. Bug with arrow when it was impossible to change arrows in a saved game.
2. Bug with health display on the button. Now it's updated with every level up. 


And now for the new MP mode.

There have been a lot of changes, let me start from the beginning.

The town becomes you home. In case of death you will be revived in the town and the map becomes fully free for travel. Please note, that pressing the Map button will teleport you to the town. By the way, when you buy a land destroyed be the skeletons, keep in mind that the skeletons are still lurking somewhere close, so it's better to enter the land and kill all of them.
:)

My favorite tactic is robbing enemy castles (if the owner is keeping something valuable in the workshops) and returning the land back to the previous owner – that way I don't have to build up my base :) But everyone has their own preferences.

I also like the fact that you can play alone in multiplayer mode – that way you have yourself a single mode without failure:)

Later we are planning to display ping in the connection window, as well as kick and ban options for the server creator. This way new players will be able to join the game, but starting with empty progress. VAC anticheat is also planned, as well as filters by server name, ping and other stats.

Now we are launching an active programming phase for new GUI and controls. This will take at least a month, since we are starting to program from scratch, but we will do our best to keep fixing bugs during that time. I am going to keep you updated on our progress! In the mean time, please get back to us with your feedback and bug reports. Thanks!

Happy hunting!
Ellada Games Team

notes.title: Niffelheim: Update 0.9.7
notes.notes:
UPD. Hotfix: bug with craft menu is fixed

Hi everyone!
Please welcome the new Niffelheim update (version 0.9.7)

All right, here is what has been added and fixed in the game.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

1. Fixed the bug with trees being cut in one strike of the axe as well as other similar issues :)
2. Fixed the bug with buildings and construction time.
3. Fixed the bug with indestructible walls around the caves.
4. We’ve added a timeout before the health of mobs and bosses starts restoring. So from now on the bosses will not regenerate right away.
5. Fixed the bug with the "Armadillo” achievement.

 [h1]New features [/h1]

I remember since the very start of the game in Early Access on Steam, there have been a lot of complaints about the Charms. Many players had difficulties grasping the idea of charms, the rules of where and how these should be activated. Many players found it awkward to activate charms on altars (instead of boss location, for example). We have read your feedback and watched replays and realized that you were actually right. :)

 
Here is the solution we have implemented as result:

1. From now on you don't have to use altars to activate charms, this can be done in your inventory. Right click a charm and choose "Activate" from the menu (the process will be easier once we introduce the new GUI system). Sometimes you'll discover charms in graves or underground dungeons.

2. Altars can now be used for crafting charms. All the charms are available at all times. Altars can also be found in underground caves.

3. You cannot activate charms in the Temple anymore, it's only purpose now is invoking of the dragon.
 
4. Fireflies.
This was another idea we've been eager to implement for some time. You cannot catch fireflies, attack them or interact with them in any way.
Cute little fireflies will protect you from health decrease under the ground. All you need to do is stand next to them. Fireflies can be found in the central dungeon as well as in the secondary ones on the sides.

5. Lamps also can be used to stop health from decreasing under the ground.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/6e1397b0ee6342fdbb8e7da60ea4f28197fa67c4.png[/img]


 [h1]This is it for the latest update. [/h1]

We are still working on the new GUI and multiplayer mode.
The next update is scheduled for 7th September. We are planning to release a finalized solution for multiplayer connection. There will be some changes, but I am going to write all about that at a later point. We are really looking forward, as everything should work out great.

We are still working on the new GUI system and controls. This is a large task, but hopefully in September we will be able to play without the context menu :)

All the best,
Ellada Games Team.

notes.title: Niffelheim: Update 0.9.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

the summer is here and it's hot outside, but we are working under the Stark house motto: "Winter is coming!" So no rest for us and please welcome the update 0.9.6!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713871/a09c226a5ecdc2dc8f0e163613ebe270894eba08.png[/img]

What is new in this version:

1. Your hero's health will gradually decrease in the dungeons as you progress deeper under the ground. Currently, the health loss is not as strong as we would like to test the feature and collect your feedback. Please let us know your thoughts.
2. You will be able to stop the health loss by placing lamps, holding a torch or activating a charm in the dungeon.
3. The lamp crafting has been simplified a little bit, so now you can craft more lamps to place under the ground. By the way, check out how cool the dungeons look with the lamps :) Each lamp type has an individual area of effect. We will add a new Steam guide with lamp parameters after careful balancing.
4. As promised before, the sigils are now activated directly from the inventory or chest (provided you have the required skills). You don't have to click the sigil again in the skill tree.
5. Mobs restore their health gradually. Earlier you could kill a boss by returning over and over again, but now its health will slowly restore while you are coming back. Other mobs also regenerate in time.

What to expect in the following update?
As mentioned before, we are trying to update the game and implement bigger improvements as well. Sometimes an update can be postponed to give us more time to work on the improvements.

1. Connection and disconnection during an online game.
2. Charm crafting and activation from the inventory. Instead of activating charms at the altars we'd like to give you the opportunity to craft the charms and activate them whenever you like: in the dungeons or during battles.


The full-scale improvements we are working on right now are a new GUI and controls system, including:
1. a quick access panel and hotkeys for quick activation;
2. moving items (also in stacks);
3. we will remove the context menu and allow activation on right click;
4. one-click item creation and collection from chests;
5. no extra windows with item count when replacing items;
6. addition of a new chat and removal of some buttons;
7. multiplayer mode with the possibility to connect and disconnect from the game without having to restart and some more MP features.

After finishing UI improvements we will continue working on the main character.
1. The hero will get a new Stamina parameter which will allow him to run faster.
2. The speed of all animations will be increased. We will adjust the defense and combat animations.
3. You will be able to remove all equipment from the character.
4. New gamepad control will be added.


After that we will the storyline implementation and adding new characters, mobs etc. following by final balancing.
Currently we are designing new characters and preparing animation and soon will continue drawing new locations.

As you can see, there is a lot of work, but thanks to your support we are able to improve and perfect the game! Thank you and have fun playing.

Ellada Games Team.

notes.title: Niffelheim: Update 0.9.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
 
we are still pushing the development forward, and are proud to announce the 0.9.5 update.
 
What's new in the game?
 
1. We are introducing a completely reworked map feature. Now you will be able to traverse between your territories for free. Travelling to town still requires some money, as usual. From now on the map displays which one of your territories is currently under attack. Quick teleport back to your castle also requires some money; however you will be able to return to your castle from other lands for free. Once you've quit to the map you will only have the options to return to your castle or travel to town. Travelling from the map to enemy territories is no longer possible.
2. We have added hero's tracks. From now on while exploring the dungeons you will see where you have already been and what parts are still unexplored.
3. Both current and overall health levels are now displayed on the hero icon, to help you track your hero's health state.
4. We have removed the door crafting option from the dungeons. Currently there is no use for doors and the feature may be removed permanently from the game.
 
Fixed errors and bugs:
1. Fixed bug with items that have not been removed while complying to an ultimatum.
2. Fixed bug with disappearing trophies after update.
3. Multiplayer mode: fixed issue when one of the players did not see a boss after respawn.
 
What to expect in the following update in 2 weeks:

A lot of you have been asking: "What do we need the lamps for? It's bright enough in the dungeons”.
Now we are planning to implement a concept that has been designed prior to Early Access launch. Your hero's health will gradually decrease in the dungeons as you progress deeper under the ground. The lamps will allow you to stop health decreasing. Each lamp has its own area of effect, but all available lamp tyoes will be required to explore dungeons. We are also planning to use torches and charms to stop health decreasing under the ground.
 
We are also planning to simplify sigil activation. The feature will be available from the UI, you won't have to open the sigil screen.

Dear players, these minor improvements and additions are being developed at the same time as some major game changes. We've already launched working on new UI screens, a new multiplayer system, new animations and new controls. We are aiming to complete the mentioned tasks until the end of summer and release a major game update. But we are still planning to release a minor update every two weeks including some of your suggestions. So please keep sending us feedback, as we are still reading carefully and considering your thoughts.
 
Be well and good luck!

Ellada Games Team

notes.title: Update ver. 0.9.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Please welcome Niffelheim update (version 0.9.2)

Before I start writing about what we’ve been up to during the last few weeks, let me tell you a bit about our plans (which are being updated after reading your feedback, by the way). Thanks for all of your feedback, videos, comments and for staying in the game :)


So, the game has been released 3 weeks ago, and these were surely some busy, but very efficient weeks. We have watched (and are still watching) all walkthroughs and reading all your feedback. We have created a document to include your ideas and suggestions. So here are a few features we will be changing (and improving) for sure:
1. Interface. There is a lot of work here, as GUI must be user-friendly for mouse and keyboard, as well as for gamepads. The interface should be intuitive and comfortable for crafting (including all inventories and chests), buying items at the shop etc. As well as… let’s move on to the next point.
2. New characters - and by that I don’t mean the mobs. Everybody put there asks for more playable characters, especially a female warrior. We see a way to add 3 more characters - to make both single and multiplayer games more fun and enjoyable :) BTW, speaking of multiplayer mode...
3. Currently we are focused on fixing bugs, and there is a lot of work on build stabilization. But we have taken some time to adopt a new multiplayer engine. This should fix the connection issues… but we are still testing the multiplayer mode. You are aware of the “infinite” world loading. Based on your feedback, we’ve decided to improve the multiplayer mode. Players will be able to host their own servers with other connecting and disconnecting (later you will also be able to choose a character on connecting to a server). 
4. Storyline. We already started working on new texts and storyline - that’s all I can say for now. 
5. Animations... A lot of work is required: from adding new animations to improving soe of the current stuff, for example, running (yes, the character will be faster!) and combat (finally, the shield will work correctly!)
6. Game play… there are a lot of ideas, I will write more on this some other time - it’s just a huge subject))

In other news: we’ve updated the Chinese localization and added an Italian version.
On behalf of the entire team I’d like to thank two of our devoted players (I’m sure the community willl join me).
Many thanks to Ken for helping us improve Chinese texts.  
And many thanks to Emanuele for translating the game to Italian!! 

In the future we will react swiftly to your localization requests. If you think anything in the texts should be corrected - please let us now. And by all means, let us know, if you are willing to translate a news post or a guide to your native language :)

Another big thanks goes out to Patch for the game guide. We will soon post an illustrated guide based on this one. 

And here is what’s new.

Technical fixes:
1. All achievements have been fixed.
2. Sigil functionality has been fixed.
3. The potions are mutually exclusive as of now. The previous potion effect is dispelled once you drink the next one.
4. Character experience gaining has been fixed.
5. Mini buildings functionality has been fixed. 
6. Issue with switching to another language has been fixed. 
7. A new multiplayer engine has been adopted. 
8. Equipment set bonuses have been fixed.
9. And a lot of small bugs!

Balance improvements:
1. The vault now includes the most precious stuff!!! (new game only). Please let us know, what you think!
2. Potions restore less HP.
3. Mobs have become tougher… but you’ll find new equipment in the boss’s chests.
4. Side dungeons have become deeper.
5. Oh, yes, it all starts with a club, but the sword is nearby, you’ll find it :) see clause 1.
6. Silver arrows do not require any titanium as of now (you are extremely observant!)
7. Dead wolves sometimes drop Rotten Eggs now… oh boy, the stuff it eats down there, in the dungeons!
8. Death penalty is higher and will cost you 20% of your gold now.
9. There will be more Dope root out there, so start brewing beer!
10. Plant gathering will not add to your Woodcutter skill anymore.
11. You will receive ultimatums later and will have more time to complete the tasks.

I guess, that’s it for now. We are keeping on our hunt for bugs and bug-fixing and continuing multiplayer testing. We are still reading your posts, so post more! And we are working on a game guide as well… very soon we will post an illustrated “Introduction”. We’ve also created a Wiki page here: http://niffelheim.wikia.com/wiki/Niffelheim_Wikia - I will start filling it with info soon. There is still a lot of work ahead of us, but we enjoy it and hope you’ll enjoy the results! 

PS. I will post more pictures when there is no news to announce )) We’re planning to update the game  every 1-2 weeks.
